verdict.rationale: The repo's skill-creator skill provides eval tooling: it can "measure skill performance," "benchmark skill performance with variance analysis," and optimize descriptions for triggering accuracy. Nothing in the evidence shows the collection itself keeps test suites, eval sets or CI regression checks for its published skills such as pptx, xlsx, docx and pdf. missing for 10: evidence of maintained per-skill tests or evals in the repo, CI or regression gating on changes, published eval results, independent corroboration.
